services.desc: When you are ready to schedule your Field Trip, please be sure to fill out the Group Visits Request Form! The Saint Louis Science Center offers something for all ages. Don’t see something for your group? Reach out and let’s start a conversation to see how we can meet the needs of your group. Through hands-on activities, students will explore the unique behaviors of blue whales and investigate real-world problems facing our seas. services.name: Yoga class
services.desc: Relax under the clearest sky in St. Louis! The evening begins with a 15-minute guided Star Show, exploring the current night sky. The lights stay low but the stars stay bright for the 60-minute yoga class that follows. Class is intended to be gentle and beginner-friendly. Please bring your own yoga mat - a small number will be available first come/first serve. Due to the dark nature of the planetarium, late admittance or reentry is not permitted.
